name: SeriaLinc
description: An interface between an Insteon network and an RS232 serial port.

steps.text: Create a CSV file with your serial codes and download the SeriaLinc Downloader application.
Plug SeriaLinc into an electrical outlet within reach of your computer with the included serial cable, or use an extension cord.
Tap the SET button on SeriaLinc to enter Configuration Mode.
Connect SeriaLinc to your computer using the included serial cable.
In the SeriaLinc Downloader application, open the CSV file.
Link the devices that respond to serial codes (defined as 1 in the CSV file) to SeriaLinc by their group number (see linking).
Choose the COM port SeriaLinc is connected to and select Download to SeriaLinc.
When prompted, unplug SeriaLinc and plug it back in, making sure not to tap the SET button.
Close the SeriaLinc Downloader application.
Plug SeriaLinc into your RS-232 device using the included null modem adapter.

notes: Configuration Mode is entered by tapping the SET button within 4 seconds of power-up, before the LED turns on. Powering up without tapping the SET button starts Serial Translation Mode.
Don't plug SeriaLinc into a switched outlet or a filtered power strip, and don't stack it with other Insteon devices.

steps.text: With SeriaLinc in Configuration Mode and connected to the computer, click the button for the group defined in the CSV file on the right side of the SeriaLinc Downloader application.
steps.expect: SeriaLinc enters that group's linking mode

steps.text: Press and hold the responder's SET button for 3 seconds.
Repeat for each group as needed.

notes: SeriaLinc is the controller of these links; the responder is each device that should respond to a serial code.

steps.text: Click the group's button in the SeriaLinc Downloader application.
Press and hold the next responder's SET button for 3 seconds.
Repeat for each responder and group.
Unplug SeriaLinc.
Wait about 10 seconds.
While holding down the SET button, plug SeriaLinc back in, making sure not to let go of the SET button.
Continue to hold down the SET button for 3 seconds.
Release the SET button.
steps.expect: After a few seconds the status LED turns on

notes: Insteon Device Categories and Product Keys (October 2008) gives 0x03/0x0A to the 2412E PowerLinc Modem Ethernet.
sources: Insteon Device Categories and Product Keys (October 2008)
